notes: Generated from docs/SCRIPT.md. No line contains a player name, sister name or placeholder.
batch = one TTS request (<=13 lines, one character, one post filter). Total requests = number of batches (quota 100/day/model).
tag = leading [bracket tag] for gemini-3.8-flash-tts. character -> voice per docs/AUDIO.md (mom Sulafat, dad Algenib, sister Leda, gran Vindemiatrix, announcer Fenrir).
fx: downstairs = through-the-floor muffle (shouts from another room); console = crunchy console filter; absent = clean.
callout: play the matching name clip first (names/out/<callout>/<name>), then this line. Generic fallback: the line alone.
Mom and Dad's lines are written to work for any player: no 'lad', no he/she, no names.
